metadata.title: P44 Verified Completion Spine and Workspace-Scoped Commit Safety
metadata.description: Normal parser-compatible PlanSpec single-file plan for P44. Uses top-level workstreams, workspace-level workstreamId, strict command policy, PlanLock, WorkerPacket echo, CompletionGate V2, EvidenceLedger, WorkspaceCommitGate, and P45 bridge artifact boundaries.

notes: PlanSpec v5 alpha2 JSON is canonical execution authority.
Generated Markdown/human preview is non-authoritative and must not be parsed for execution.
ACCP is evidence/report protocol only; reports do not authorize execution.

P43.9 V5 runtime foundation is assumed available: PlanLock admission, WorkerPacketV5, worker echo extraction, CompletionGate V2 path, EvidenceLedger hooks, P45 boundary guard, and read-model truth population.

locking.description: Plan and workspace locks for integrity verification

mission.text: Implement P44 as Verified Completion Spine and Workspace-Scoped Commit Safety. Worker COMPLETE is claim-only; CompletionGate V2 and ExecutionKernel are the completion authorities; WorkspaceCommitGate is the repository commit authority.

hardRequirements.text: Runtime compatibility target is v4.1.1, but PlanSpec v5 JSON is the canonical execution contract.
Worker self-report is claim-only and cannot transition workspace state.
Every required acceptance criterion requires evidence.
Write/edit operations must pass WriteGate or SmartMutationEngine.
Workspace commits must pass WorkspaceCommitGate and stage exactly acceptedWriteSet.
Final validation must use exact allowed commands.
P45 bridge work is artifact-only; P45 runtime implementation remains forbidden.

antiPatterns.text: Do not create a module and leave it unwired.
Do not hide machine-critical behavior in prose.
Do not parse generated Markdown preview for execution.
Do not use worker self-report as evidence.
Do not stage whole repository with git add ., git add -A, or git commit -a.
Do not claim promotion if make test, make test-full, fake-complete gauntlet, or commit-scope gauntlet is missing.

operatorNotes.text: Human preview is non-authoritative; this JSON is the only execution contract.
Spec changes after locking require a new lock or approved amendment.
P44 prepares P45 only by exporting artifacts; it must not implement async assembly runtime.

instructions.text: Worker VERDICT: COMPLETE is claim-only; require structured WorkerCompletionReport with workspaceId, attemptId, verdictClaim, filesChanged, commandsRun, acceptanceCoverage, negativeChecks, limitations.
In planspec_locked mode, worker report must echo planLockHash and workspaceLockHash and missing/mismatched echo must block completion.
Parser must reject prose-only all done/complete reports.
